Jenna (Design): Quick check on the Create Token modal copy and keyboard flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/token-create. Main things: default expiry text, one-time secret messaging, and revoke patterns.

Ava (PM): Key asks: make defaults visible (90d org / 30d personal), and add undo for revoke (10s).

Luis (Eng): Backend flags ready: we'll return `x-token-admin=true` when admin scopes selected. Use that to surface stronger warning.

Sam (A11y): Important: when the secret is revealed move focus into the token region and announce: "New token revealed. Copy now, it will not be shown again." Ensure the reveal is reachable by keyboard before the copy button.

Maya (Security): Add an extra checkbox on org-level revokes: "I understand revoking will affect services." Require it to enable Revoke. Also typed confirm for very high-impact tokens.

Jenna (Design): Empty state copy idea: "No API tokens yet. Create one to get started. Tokens are shown once94copy them now." CTA: "Create token".

Luis (Eng): Minor: include `token.visibility=one-time` in analytics payload when secret is returned.

Ava (PM): Cool. Jenna, please update Figma with the accessibility notes and the revoke checkbox. I'll file analytics and backend tickets.

Jenna (Design): On it. Will ping when updated. :thumbsup:
